tested_workflows: Dictation is off by default; turning it on shows a transmission notice and can be declined
Live words appear while recording; stopping fills the answer box without ticking the confirmation box
Pause and resume follow the recorder; a browser ending a silent session restarts without losing words
Recognition errors keep the recording and explain the reason; typed answers are never overwritten
The answer area stays locked until dictation settles, so self-check cannot run on half-finished text
Self-check marks example words said/missing and finds target expressions through tense changes and placeholders
Sentence cards (captions, PDF lines) show only the word comparison, not the source sentence as a target
Learner text and example text are HTML-escaped in the comparison
Saved dictation preference must be a boolean in backups

limits.speech_service: No real human speech was recognised in this environment; recognition results were mocked. Real Chromium reported audio-capture because the container has no real audio input.
limits.on_device_recognition: Not used. SpeechRecognition.available() crashed a headless Chromium 141 page in testing; full Chromium 141 returned "downloadable" without crashing.
limits.comparison: Reference only, not a score. Different wording lowers the overlap; pronunciation is not assessed.
